support: I=sorted(unique(S0) intersection merged nonzero legal S_true); threshold0 after complex merge; all four arms same I, no added atoms
observation: raw y; Phi_I=G_I times already-scaled pilot; no true data cancellation, no true gains in fit interface
terminal: Hfit for both cancellation and data detection; original BP20 + LDPC50; all arms use same normal B_star sigma2_terminal unchanged
physical_template: Reuse physical_cluster_weights(system,{taps,l_i,k_real}) then restrict rows to I. Normalized unknown physical gains estimated by LS, never provided. No post-fit Frobenius normalization.
free: complex SVD least squares Phi_I g=y; eps64*max(shape) relative rank cutoff
link: SVD LS Phi_I L_I h=y, emit only I coefficients L_I h; rank-deficient min-norm identifiable solution, no individual path identifiability claim
sham: L_sham=diag(exp(2pi*j*frac((atom_id+1)*sqrt(2)))) L_I; frozen across campaign. Preserves incidence, slot count, singular values and rank of L. Log projector difference and conditioning. Degenerate sham marked not_testable, never redraw.

group.overlap: one coefficient per unique atom; ADMM copies constrained equal, no independent latent extra coefficients
group.failure: nonconvergence or numerical failure explicit; no silent LS fallback, no result-based tuning

empty_I: zero-dimensional common model, retain frame, each scheduled fit and terminal accounted
truth_recovery: Regenerate frozen CampaignData for same split/block/SNR; match all input hashes to disk normal frame before extracting path geometry. Costs separately accounted; no receiver rerun.
limitations: Oracle diagnostic; same support deletion shared by all arms. Pilot-only observation includes unknown SP data interference. Chosen group prior is one frozen classical reference, not exhaustive strongest possible grouped method.
